extracted.intended_audience: owners/operators of CCR units; facility environmental/compliance officers; regulated entities required to maintain CCR websites
extracted.subtask_description: Lists the specific documents, reports, notifications, certifications, demonstrations, and decisions that owners/operators of coal combustion residual (CCR) units must place on their CCR website, with cross-references to the applicable regulatory subsections and retention/posting-duration instructions.
